overview.zh: 资金与信任的追索成为主线：被盗资产加速混币、AI 代理支付落地、联邦机构清退 DeepSeek。 加密：与 Drift 关联的钱包向 Tornado Cash 转入 5480 万美元 ETH AI：eMudhra 中间证书颁发机构被攻陷 AI 合规：国土安全部命令即时生效，联邦文职机构须移除 DeepSeek 产品及基于其技术构建的第三方服务，并停止新采购。
overview.en: Tracing and trust dominate: stolen funds move through mixers, AI agent payments go live, and US agencies purge DeepSeek. Fund tracing：Drift-linked wallets moved 25,700 ETH into Tornado Cash in about two hours, a second mixing round after July, while the DFX pool pays early claimants roughly a penny per dollar. AI：EMudhra Intermediate CA Compromise AI compliance：The DHS order took immediate effect, requiring civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek products and third-party services built on its technology and barring new purchases.

title.zh: 与 Drift 关联的钱包向 Tornado Cash 转入 5480 万美元 ETH
title.en: Drift-Linked Wallet Sends $54.8 Million in ETH to Tornado Cash

summary.zh:
与 4 月 1 日 Drift Protocol 漏洞事件相关的钱包在周二约两小时内分批向混币器 Tornado Cash 转入 25,700 枚 ETH（按当前价格约 6156 万美元，此为正文给出的数字，标题中写作 5480 万美元）。这些地址在转账前已沉寂约两个月。

这是该攻击者已知的第二轮混币操作，此前在 7 月 23 日和 24 日已有约 23,095 枚 ETH 转入 Tornado Cash；此举使大部分尚未追回的资金更加难以追回，而 Drift 的 DFX 赔偿池目前对早期申领者仅按每 1 美元核实损失约 1 美分兑付。

Arkham Intelligence 数据显示，这些转账以每批 100 枚 ETH（约 23.78 万美元）为主，另有更小的 10 枚 ETH 批次，与该混币器的固定存款池规模相符。转账完成后，Arkham 追踪的 71 个攻击者关联地址仍持有 81,454 枚 ETH，价值约 1.9858 亿美元，另有约 56.16 万美元的 USDT、USDC、Solana 和 USDY。
summary.en:
Wallets tied to the April 1 Drift Protocol exploit moved 25,700 ETH — about $61.56 million at current prices, the figure reported in the source body, while the headline cited $54.8 million — into the mixer Tornado Cash in batches over roughly two hours on Tuesday. The addresses had been inactive for about two months before the transfers.

The deposits are the second known mixing round by the exploiter, after about 23,095 ETH was sent to Tornado Cash on July 23 and 24, and they move a large part of the unrecovered haul further from recovery as Drift's DFX recovery pool pays early claimants roughly a penny per dollar of verified loss.

Arkham Intelligence data shows the deposits arrived in batches of 100 ETH — about $237,800 each — plus smaller 10 ETH chunks, sizes that match the mixer's fixed deposit pools. After the transfers, the 71 addresses tracked under the attacker entity still held 81,454 ETH, worth roughly $198.58 million, plus about $561,600 in USDT, USDC, Solana and USDY.

title.zh: 新型中心化洗钱服务 FreedomXMR（FXMR）现身 Hyperliquid Core
title.en: A new centralized laundering service FreedomXMR (FXMR) appeared on Hyperliquid C

summary.zh:
链上调查员 ZachXBT 发文称，2026 年 8 月出现在 Hyperliquid Core 上的中心化洗钱服务 FreedomXMR（FXMR），其超过 87% 的流入交易量与非法活动直接相关。他对 FXMR 历史上单笔超过 1 万美元的流入进行人工审查，发现逾 2000 万美元资金可直接追溯至勒索软件、漏洞攻击、恶意软件及社交工程事件，并已将相关数据表格分享给 Hyperliquid 团队。

该披露指认 Hyperliquid Core 多次被洗钱服务用作通道，ZachXBT 表示该链此前还出现过 b1exch 等利用其无需许可设计的服务。相关证据已提交 Hyperliquid 团队，但目前未有该团队采取行动的确认消息。

被追溯的事件包括 2026 年 9 月的 DCENT Wallet、Fetch.ai、Axelar 攻击与一笔未具名勒索软件付款，以及 2026 年 10 月的 Gamdom 攻击。ZachXBT 称 FXMR 管理员通过 KuCoin 获取门罗币流动性，相关地址累计向该交易所存入超过 3000 次，运作模式可能与 Wagyu 的兑换模式类似；FXMR 代币代码于 2026 年 7 月 27 日通过 Hyperliquid 拍卖以 518.28 枚 HYPE（约 2.8 万美元）购得。
summary.en:
On-chain investigator ZachXBT reported that FreedomXMR (FXMR), a centralized money-laundering service that appeared on Hyperliquid Core in August 2026, has more than 87% of its inflow volume tied directly to illicit activity. A manual review of all historical FXMR inflows above $10,000 traced over $20 million to ransomware, exploit, malware and social-engineering incidents, and the supporting spreadsheet was shared with the Hyperliquid team.

The disclosure names Hyperliquid Core as a channel repeatedly used by laundering services, and ZachXBT said the chain has previously hosted operations such as b1exch that exploit its permissionless design. The evidence has been handed to the Hyperliquid team, but no confirmation of action by the team was reported.

The traced incidents include the DCENT Wallet, Fetch.ai and Axelar exploits and an unnamed ransomware payment in September 2026, plus the Gamdom exploit in October 2026. ZachXBT said the FXMR admin sources XMR liquidity from KuCoin with more than 3,000 deposits to the exchange, likely using a swap model similar to Wagyu's; the FXMR ticker was bought in a Hyperliquid auction on July 27, 2026 for 518.28 HYPE (about $28,000).

title.zh: FN 速递丨两度延期后合并上线，Aero 告别 ve(3,3) 经济模型
title.en: FN Brief | Launching After Two Delays, Aero Bids Farewell to the ve(3,3) Economic Model

summary.zh:
Aero 在两次延期后完成合并上线，用与收入挂钩的新代币经济模型取代原有的 ve(3,3) 模型，取消每周投票与固定排放表，并将业务拓展至七条链。团队表示，该协议已在 Base 上为持有人赚取超过 5 亿美元。

此次改造改变了 Base 主要流动性枢纽的激励与治理方式：由每周投票决定排放的机制，转为与协议收入挂钩的体系。

被弃用的 ve(3,3) 设计结合了 Curve 式的投票托管机制与 Olympus DAO 的 (3,3) 模型，锁仓者每轮投票决定排放流向。Aero 的新方案将代币经济与收入挂钩，同时取消每周投票周期和固定排放表。
summary.en:
Aero completed its twice-delayed merger launch and replaced its ve(3,3) tokenomics with a revenue-linked model, scrapping weekly voting and the fixed emission schedule while expanding to seven chains. The team said the protocol has earned more than $500 million for holders on Base.

The overhaul changes how incentives and governance work at Base's main liquidity hub: weekly vote-directed emissions give way to a system tied to protocol revenue.

The ve(3,3) design it abandons combined Curve-style vote escrow with Olympus DAO's (3,3) mechanism, in which lockers vote on where emissions go each epoch. Aero's replacement ties token economics to revenue and drops both the weekly voting cycle and the fixed emission table.

title.zh: eMudhra 中间证书颁发机构被攻陷

summary.zh:
eMudhra 的中间 ECC 证书颁发机构被发现私钥实际上可被猜测——据报道只有一个字节（其中一个私钥字面值就是“4”），根源在于某一天用于生成这些 ECC 签发者的 KGC 脚本存在缺陷。浏览器厂商随即撤销了对相关中间 CA 的信任，而未采用现代吊销机制的非浏览器 TLS 客户端仍暴露在风险之中。

由于这些中间 CA 属于公开受信任的机构，任何能猜出私钥的人都可以为任意域名伪造证书，而这种风险在生态中的分布极不均衡。一位 Mozilla 工程师表示，Firefox 用户通过 OneCRL 在两小时内即自动获得保护，Chrome、Apple 和 Microsoft 也有类似机制，但“生态中的其余部分在吊销机制上几乎没有任何投入”。

在 Mozilla 缺陷报告 2083449 中，eMudhra 表示初步评估发现“当天用于创建这些 ECC 签发者的 KGC 脚本存在缺陷”，并称对 KGC 代码和 HSM 密钥的审查迄今显示：一组原始 ECC 密钥按预期在硬件内生成，此外还存在一项对其常规 KGC 流程的获批偏离。社区讨论提到共有 8 个受影响的 CA，一位评论者称这些密钥据称是在某个公开仓库 URL 上被发现的，同时表示不确定这些文件说明的是密钥被窃取，还是密钥生成过程本身过弱。
summary.en:
eMudhra's intermediate ECC certificate authorities were found to have effectively guessable private keys, reportedly single-byte values (one of them literally "4"), traced to a flaw in the KGC script used on a specific day to create those ECC issuers. Browser vendors responded by revoking trust in the affected intermediates, while non-browser TLS clients that do not use modern revocation tooling remain exposed.

Because the intermediate CAs were publicly trusted, anyone who could guess the keys could have forged certificates for arbitrary domains, and that risk falls unevenly across the ecosystem. A Mozilla engineer said Firefox users were protected automatically within a couple of hours via OneCRL, with Chrome, Apple and Microsoft operating similar tooling, but "for the rest of the ecosystem, there has been little to no investment in revocation."

In Mozilla bug 2083449, eMudhra said its preliminary assessment found "a flaw in the KGC script that was used on that specific day to create these ECC issuers," and that review of the KGC code and HSM keys so far indicates a set of original ECC keys was created onboard as expected plus an approved deviation to its usual KGC. Community reports describe eight affected CAs, and one commenter said the keys were allegedly found at a public repository URL, while noting uncertainty about whether the artifacts show stolen keys or a weak generation process.

title.zh: 美国下令联邦机构从各自系统中移除中国DeepSeek人工智能
title.en: US orders federal agencies to remove China’s DeepSeek AI from their systems

summary.zh:
美国国土安全部于周一提交、周二公布一项命令，要求联邦文职机构从各自的IT系统中移除DeepSeek产品、其关联方，以及任何使用DeepSeek技术开发的第三方产品或服务。该指令即时生效，同时禁止受影响的机构进行新的采购。

该命令将此前仅适用于商务部以及国防、安全和情报部门部分机构的限制，扩大到整个联邦文职系统及其承包商。国土安全部警告称，员工和承包商使用DeepSeek可能使敏感信息暴露给中国。

国土安全部援引2018年《联邦采购供应链安全法》，并提到DeepSeek服务器位于中国，以及在DeepSeek iOS应用中发现了安全漏洞。该部门表示，相关技术可能泄露有关美国公民和联邦项目的细节。
summary.en:
The US Department of Homeland Security issued an order, filed Monday and published Tuesday, directing federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek products, its affiliates, and any third-party products or services built using DeepSeek technology from their IT systems. The directive took immediate effect and also bars affected agencies from making new purchases.

The order extends restrictions that had previously applied to the Commerce Department and parts of the defense, security and intelligence community to the whole federal civilian workforce and its contractors. DHS warned that employee and contractor use of DeepSeek could expose sensitive information to China.

DHS invoked the Federal Acquisition Supply Chain Security Act of 2018 and cited DeepSeek servers located in China as well as security vulnerabilities identified in DeepSeek's iOS application. The department said the technology could reveal details about US citizens and federal programs.

title.zh: 万事达卡在与Coinbase、Base和Cloudflare完成试点后，开放AI代理支付早期接入
title.en: Mastercard opens early access to AI agent payments following pilots with Coinbase, Base and Cloudflare

summary.zh:
万事达卡已开放名为“Agent Pay for Machines”系统的早期接入，允许自主运行的软件代理在人类预设的支出上限内发现服务、协商条款并完成支付。该公司在Cloudflare Connect大会上公布了这一进展，万事达卡的Jorn Lambert现场演示了一笔实际交易。

万事达卡将该系统定位为解决一个具体痛点：目前付费在线服务通常要求用户与每个服务商建立账户、API密钥或账单关系，当AI代理临时挑选服务时这一模式便无法运转。此次开放早期接入之前，万事达卡已与Cloudflare、蚂蚁国际、AWS、BVNK和Coinbase开展了端到端试点。

Agent Pay for Machines基于开放的x402协议构建：当AI代理访问需付费的服务并收到“402 Payment Required”响应时，会生成一份经数字签名的支付凭证，服务提供方验证后交付服务，凭证可批量兑付。演示中，营销机构Hype的代理在单一预算下向两家独立商户完成了9笔支付，用于推广蛋白棒产品；Coinbase提供钱包，Base负责链上结算，BVNK通过万事达卡Global Money Platform处理法币或稳定币的支付与结算。万事达卡还将向开发者提供买方与卖方API、开发工具包及测试环境。
summary.en:
Mastercard has opened early access to a system called Agent Pay for Machines, which lets autonomous software agents discover services, agree to terms and pay for them within human-set spending limits. The company unveiled the milestone at Cloudflare's Connect conference, where Mastercard's Jorn Lambert demonstrated a live transaction.

Mastercard frames the system as a fix for a specific friction: paid online services typically require an account, API key or billing relationship with each provider, which breaks down when an agent selects services on the fly. The launch follows end-to-end pilots with Cloudflare, Ant International, AWS, BVNK and Coinbase.

Agent Pay for Machines builds on the open x402 protocol: when an agent hits a paid service returning a "402 Payment Required" response, it generates a digitally signed payment voucher that the provider verifies before delivering the service, with vouchers batchable for later redemption. In the demo, an agent for marketing agency Hype ran a protein-bar campaign across nine payments to two independent merchants on a single budget, with Coinbase supplying the wallet, Base providing on-chain settlement, and BVNK handling fiat or stablecoin settlement through Mastercard's Global Money Platform; Mastercard is also releasing buyer- and seller-side APIs, a developer toolkit and a testing environment.

title.zh: 【Webull 将于 11 月向美国用户开放永续合约交易，首批涵盖比特币等加密资产】
title.en: Webull to Open Perpetual Futures Trading to US Users in November, Initially Covering Bitcoin and Other Crypto Assets

summary.zh:
在线投资平台 Webull（NASDAQ: BULL）将于 11 月起向符合条件的美国客户开放永续合约交易，首批产品包括比特币和其他加密资产，并计划在年底前扩大开放范围。该永续合约将在 CFTC 监管的指定合约市场 KalshiEX 挂牌，并由 CFTC 监管的衍生品清算机构 Kalshi Klear 负责清算，用户可通过现有 Webull 期货账户直接交易。

此次上线让已获批期货交易资格的美国零售客户可以通过 CFTC 监管的场所交易加密永续合约，而这一产品此前对美国用户主要在场外平台交易。初期仅面向已获批期货交易资格的客户开放。

Webull 表示，该业务将于 11 月启动，并计划在年底前扩大适用范围；交易通过现有的 Webull 期货账户进行，而非新设加密专属产品线。相关产品在 KalshiEX 挂牌，由 Kalshi Klear 清算。
summary.en:
Online investment platform Webull (NASDAQ: BULL) will begin offering perpetual futures trading to eligible US customers starting in November, with Bitcoin and other crypto assets among the first products, and plans to widen access before the end of the year. The contracts will be listed on KalshiEX, a CFTC-designated contract market, and cleared by Kalshi Klear, a CFTC-regulated derivatives clearing organization, and can be traded directly through existing Webull futures accounts.

The launch gives futures-approved US retail clients access to crypto perpetual futures through CFTC-regulated venues, a product that has largely traded on offshore platforms for US users. Access is limited at first to customers already approved for futures trading.

Webull said the rollout starts in November with a planned expansion of eligibility by year-end; trading runs through existing Webull futures accounts rather than a new crypto-specific product line. The products are listed on KalshiEX and cleared by Kalshi Klear.

title.zh: Strive优先股SATS在纳斯达克上市，IPO募资6.3亿美元，年固定股息率达15%
title.en: Strive's Preferred Stock SATS Lists on Nasdaq, Raising $630 Million in IPO With a 15% Annual Fixed Dividend

summary.zh:
由Matt Cole担任董事长的纳斯达克上市比特币财库公司Strive于10月20日完成SATS优先股扩大规模IPO，以每股90美元发行700万股，募资总额6.3亿美元，并在纳斯达克挂牌交易。该优先股按100美元票面金额计算年固定股息率15%，股息具累积性，计划自11月9日起每个营业日支付，但需经董事会宣派。

该交易为公开市场投资者提供了一款由比特币财库公司发行、按日付息、年息15%的收益型工具，Strive表示募集资金可能用于增持比特币以及补充营运资金和投资创收资产。不过公司并未说明具体有多少募资将实际用于购买比特币。

Strive估计在扣除承销折扣、佣金和费用后，净募资约6.0815亿美元；按 illustrative 的82,500美元比特币价格计算，这笔资金可购买约7,372枚BTC，将使其披露持仓从36,818枚增至约44,190枚，并可能超过Metaplanet披露的44,000枚。按90美元发行价计算，每年15美元的票面股息相当于购买价约16.67%；首席风险官Jeff Walton表示公司没有债务或到期偿付压力，唯一义务是支付股息。
summary.en:
Strive, a Nasdaq-listed Bitcoin treasury company chaired by Matt Cole, closed an upsized IPO of its SATS preferred stock on Oct. 20, selling 7 million shares at $90 each for $630 million in gross proceeds and listing the stock on Nasdaq. The preferred carries a 15% annual fixed dividend on its $100 stated amount, is cumulative, and is scheduled to be paid each business day starting Nov. 9, subject to board declaration.

The deal gives public-market investors a daily-paid, 15%-yielding instrument issued by a Bitcoin treasury company, and Strive has said proceeds may fund additional Bitcoin purchases alongside working capital and income-generating assets. However, the company has not specified how much of the proceeds will actually go to Bitcoin.

Strive estimated net proceeds of about $608.15 million after underwriting discounts, commissions and expenses; at an illustrative Bitcoin price of $82,500, that amount could buy roughly 7,372 BTC, which would lift reported holdings from 36,818 BTC to about 44,190 BTC and potentially exceed Metaplanet's reported 44,000 BTC. At the $90 IPO price, the $15 annual stated dividend equals about 16.67% of the purchase price, and chief risk officer Jeff Walton said the company carries no debt or maturities and is focused on a single obligation: paying dividends.

title.zh: Liquid称比特币兑换已恢复，而锚定转出仍被冻结
title.en: Liquid Says Bitcoin Swaps Are Restored While Peg-Outs Stay Frozen

summary.zh:
Liquid表示已恢复其网络上的比特币兑换交易，但锚定转出仍然冻结，在安全事件持续期间，用户仍无法将L-BTC兑换回比特币主网上的BTC。

锚定转出持续冻结意味着服务恢复只是部分完成：用户可以在Liquid上交易，但将价值转回比特币主网的通道仍然关闭。

Liquid的锚定转出机制负责将L-BTC兑换回比特币主网上的BTC；恢复兑换交易本身并不会重新开放这一赎回通道。
summary.en:
Liquid said it has restored Bitcoin swap trading on its network, but peg-outs remain frozen, leaving users unable to redeem L-BTC for BTC on the Bitcoin mainchain amid an ongoing security incident.

The continued peg-out freeze means service restoration is only partial: users can trade on Liquid, but the path for moving value back to Bitcoin’s mainchain remains closed.

Liquid’s peg-out mechanism converts L-BTC back to BTC on the Bitcoin mainchain; restoring swaps does not by itself reopen that redemption channel.

title.zh: Coinbase 将于 10 月 30 日把 USDT、DAI、PYUSD 兑换为 USDC，此举在德国法律下构成应税事件。
title.en: Coinbase will convert USDT, DAI, PYUSD to USDC on Oct 30, triggering taxable events under German law.

summary.zh:
Coinbase 将于 10 月 30 日自动把德国用户的 USDT、DAI 和 PYUSD 余额兑换为 USDC。由于是交易所代用户执行兑换，该操作在德国法律下被视为应税事件，而非一次中性的余额调整。

该政策迫使受影响的德国用户持有 USDC，而且按消息源所述，用户会在并非自己发起的兑换中背上税务负担。这也显示交易所在单一司法辖区内把稳定币余额引导向自家偏好的美元代币。

兑换定于 10 月 30 日执行，涉及三种第三方稳定币——Tether 的 USDT、MakerDAO 的 DAI 和 PayPal 的 PYUSD——而 USDC 不在兑换范围内。消息源把由此产生的税务处理与德国针对个人加密资产的一年持有期规则联系在一起。
summary.en:
Coinbase will automatically convert German users' USDT, DAI and PYUSD balances into USDC on October 30. Because the exchange is converting the assets on users' behalf, the swap is treated as a taxable event under German law rather than a neutral balance change.

The policy forces affected German users to hold USDC and, per the source, leaves them with a tax liability attached to a conversion they did not initiate. It also shows an exchange steering stablecoin balances toward its own preferred dollar token in a single jurisdiction.

The conversion is scheduled for October 30 and applies to three third-party stablecoins — Tether's USDT, MakerDAO's DAI and PayPal's PYUSD — while leaving USDC untouched. The source frames the resulting tax treatment alongside Germany's one-year holding-period rule for private crypto holdings.

title.zh: 摩根大通预测比特币将成为未来十年回报最高的资产，超过美股和黄金
title.en: JPMorgan predicts Bitcoin will be the highest-return asset of the next decade, beating US stocks and gold

summary.zh:
摩根大通资产管理于10月19日（周一）发布《2027年长期资本市场假设》报告，首次将比特币纳入长期收益预测，预计其未来10至15年复合年化收益率为10%。这一数字高于该机构对美国大型股的7.5%、美国房地产投资信托基金（REITs）的8.2%、黄金的5.5%以及经典60/40股债组合的7%，同时给出20.9%的算术平均年收益率和55%的年化波动率。

Bitwise首席投资官Matt Hougan表示，摩根大通将比特币列为未来十年预期表现最佳的资产，背后代表传统金融机构对加密资产态度的转变。该预测出自美国最大银行旗下的资产管理公司，使比特币在这份被机构配置者作为参考的报告中与主流资产并列。

报告称“首次为比特币收益给出区间，但尚未将比特币纳入主要协方差矩阵”，而是另外构建了一个规模较小的对比矩阵，理由是比特币波动性高、相关性不稳定。报告同时反驳了一种流行的看涨逻辑，认为“货币贬值将促使资金涌入加密资产”的说法“偏离实际”。
summary.en:
J.P. Morgan Asset Management's 2027 Long-Term Capital Market Assumptions, released Monday, Oct. 19, included bitcoin for the first time, projecting a 10% compound annual return over the next 10 to 15 years. That tops its forecasts for US large-cap stocks (7.5%), US REITs (8.2%), gold (5.5%) and a classic 60/40 stock-bond portfolio (7%), with an arithmetic mean return of 20.9% and 55% annualized volatility.

Bitwise Chief Investment Officer Matt Hougan framed the inclusion as a sign of traditional financial institutions' shifting stance toward crypto. The forecast comes from the asset management arm of the largest US bank, putting bitcoin on the same table as mainstream assets in a report institutional allocators use as reference.

JPMorgan said that "for the first time, we put a range on bitcoin returns, though we do not yet include bitcoin in our main covariance matrices," and instead built a separate, smaller comparison matrix, citing volatility and unstable correlations. The report also pushed back on a popular bull case, calling the idea that currency debasement will spark a rush into crypto "wide of the mark."

title.zh: 研究人员在网上发现 AI 聊天记录后，Meta 暂停 Muse 分享功能
title.en: Meta pauses Muse sharing after researchers find AI chats on the web

summary.zh:
Meta 表示已暂停 Muse 的一项分享功能——该功能允许用户分享与这款 AI 助手的对话。此前，安全公司 Claroc 的研究人员通过公开的 DNS 记录发现了超过 6,800 条可公开访问的 Muse 聊天链接，Ars Technica 报道了这一消息。Claroc 本周发布了相关报告。

这次暂停是针对一起隐私暴露事件的产品层面应对，而用户此前可能以为这些对话只在小范围内被分享。

据报道，这些链接是通过公开的 DNS 记录被定位到的，而非由 Meta 主动披露。Meta 称该分享功能为“暂停”，并非永久移除。
summary.en:
Meta said it has paused a Muse feature that lets users share conversations with its AI assistant, after researchers at security firm Claroc found more than 6,800 publicly accessible Muse chat links through public DNS records, Ars Technica reported. Claroc published its findings in a report this week.

The pause is a product-level response to a privacy exposure involving conversations users may have assumed were shared narrowly.

According to the reporting, the links were located through public DNS records rather than through any internal disclosure by Meta. Meta describes the sharing feature as paused, not permanently removed.

title.zh: 谷歌开源 TorchTPU：面向 TPU 的原生 PyTorch 后端
title.en: Google open-sources TorchTPU, a native PyTorch back end for TPUs

summary.zh:
谷歌已开源 TorchTPU，这是一个原生 PyTorch 后端，可让 PyTorch 工作负载直接在谷歌的张量处理器（TPU）上运行。谷歌在开发者博客中详细介绍了该项目，称其采用“Eager First（优先即时执行）”设计并集成 XLA，目的是简化模型向 TPU 基础设施的迁移。

PyTorch 是模型开发的主流框架，官方一方支持消除了一个长期障碍——此前团队若要用 TPU，往往需要绕过 XLA 适配，或干脆留在 TensorFlow/JAX 上。社区评论认为，这一发布加速了开发者远离 TensorFlow 的趋势，并扩大了 PyTorch 代码可适配的加速器范围。

该项目最早由路透社在去年 12 月报道，如今谷歌正式确认并披露了细节；The Stack 报道称，谷歌投入了多名员工专职构建该后端。谷歌开发者博客将 XLA 集成以及在 TPU 基础设施上实现峰值效率作为核心目标。
summary.en:
Google has open-sourced TorchTPU, a native PyTorch backend that lets PyTorch workloads run directly on its Tensor Processing Units (TPUs). Google detailed the project on its developer blog, describing an "Eager First" design and XLA integration intended to simplify migrating models to TPU infrastructure.

PyTorch is the dominant framework for model development, so first-party support removes a long-standing barrier that forced teams to bridge through XLA or stay on TensorFlow/JAX to use TPUs. Community commenters framed the release as accelerating the shift away from TensorFlow and widening the set of accelerators PyTorch code can target.

The project was first reported by Reuters in December, and Google has now officially confirmed and detailed it; The Stack reports that multiple Google staff were dedicated to building the backend. Google's developer blog highlights XLA integration and peak-efficiency execution on TPU infrastructure as core goals.

summary.zh:
OpenAI 周二宣布收购旧金山初创公司 Orchestra Bio，该公司的人工智能代理用于跟踪和协调药物研发项目；其团队与平台将被并入 OpenAI 面向生物学家和化学家的 AI 模型与工具套件 Rosalind。交易金额未披露。

OpenAI 表示，目标是帮助科学家做出发现，并管理将这些发现转化为更快惠及患者的疗法所需的工作；合并后的团队将构建智能代理，把科学发现与把有希望的结果转化为药物所需的决策和后续研究连接起来。

Orchestra 的智能代理会推演诸如生产批次失败等挫折如何在药物项目中传导，并比较可能的应对方案，最终决定权仍掌握在科学家和项目负责人手中。Orchestra 成立于 2022 年秋季，种子轮融资来自 Andreessen Horowitz、Definition Capital、Insight Partners 和 8VC，累计约 2000 万美元；该公司与在纳斯达克上市、代码为 OBIO 的医疗器械公司 Orchestra BioMed 无关。
summary.en:
OpenAI announced Tuesday that it has acquired Orchestra Bio, a San Francisco startup whose AI agents track and coordinate drug development programs, and will fold its team and platform into Rosalind, OpenAI's suite of AI models and tools for biologists and chemists. Financial terms were not disclosed.

OpenAI said the goal is to help scientists make discoveries and manage the work needed to turn them into treatments that reach patients sooner, and that the combined team will build agents connecting scientific findings with the decisions and follow-up studies required to turn a promising result into a medicine.

Orchestra's agents map how setbacks such as a failed manufacturing batch ripple through a drug program and compare possible responses, while scientists and program leaders keep the final decision. Founded in the fall of 2022, Orchestra raised a seed round from Andreessen Horowitz, Definition Capital, Insight Partners and 8VC totaling about $20 million; it is unrelated to Nasdaq-listed medical device maker Orchestra BioMed (ticker OBIO).
